replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
looks like another "standard" map that looks identical to most maps in layout 

it's too blocky as others stated
no unique shapes
The amount of space on each small middle island is limited cause of the giant fountains things  that really serve no purpose 

not enough pictures too

the premaid water pit looks like a pain to handle when defending 


looks fine for gameplay though other than the water pits/mid space


Good job
i see improvement in the both builders of the map since their first maps and this map is probably the best one you've guys made with aesthetics and gameplay in mind
